title: WPSS/1068/2025 of SUNDAR SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 1068 of 2025 (S/S)
Sundar Singh ........Petitioner

Present:-
Mr. Mukul Singh Dangi, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. R.S. Bisht, Additional C.S.C. for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 By means of the instant petition, the petitioner seeks the
following reliefs:-
(i) Issue an appropriate writ order or direction in the nature of
mandamus to directing the respondents to forthwith pay the
balance arrears of salary amounting to Rs. 1,80,538/- (One
Lakh Eighty Thousand Five Hundred Thirty Eight Rupees
Only) to the Petitioner, as detailed in Annexure No.4 to this
writ petition.
(ii) Issue an appropriate writ order or direction in the nature of
mandamus to directing the Respondents to pay interest on the
aforesaid balance arrears of salary at the interest rate of 9%
per annum from the date the arrears became due till the date
of actual payment, as a compensation for the undue delay.
(iii) Issue any suitable writ, order or direction, which this Hon'ble
Court may deem fit and proper on the basis of the facts and
circumstances of the case.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the
petitioner was working in Government Inter College, Jainoli, Tarikhet,
District Almora. After 36 years of service, he superannuated on
31.07.2023, but yet the department has not paid arrears of the salary
to the tune of Rs. 1,80,538/-. It is argued by learned counsel for the
petitioner that, in fact, the Principal of the college had sought Budget
from the Finance Officer, School Education, Almora, vide its

2
communication dated 15.04.2025, Annexure No.4 to the writ petition;
the petitioner's dues have been admitted by the department; the dues
have yet not been paid; it is arrears of salary.
4. Learned State Counsel would submit that the
respondents may be directed to pay the salary, and if there is any
impediment, that may be notified to the petitioner.
5. The Court does not see any reason to withhold the salary
of any employee, who has superannuated in the year 2023. In fact,
Annexure No.4 is the communication of the Principal of Government
Inter College, Jainoli, Tarikhet, District Almora, addressed to the
Finance Officer, School Education, Almora, by which categorically the
budget for arrears of salary of the petitioner has been demanded to the
tune of Rs. 1,80,538/-. Had there been any impediment, the
respondent authorities would have communicated the petitioner by
now. Therefore, this Court is of the view that this writ petition may be
decided by directing the respondent no.4/Chief Education Officer,
Almora, to ensure payment.
6. The writ petition is allowed, accordingly.
7. The respondent no.4, Chief Education Officer, Almora, is
directed to ensure that the petitioner is paid Rs. 1,80,538/- against
arrears of payment within four weeks from today without fail along
with interest at the rate of 6 per cent per annum.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J)
 25.06.2025
Ravi Bisht
